title: The Great Spreadsheet of Spring
skyStory: The moon has slipped out of its Leo crown and into Virgo at sixty-six percent, and it immediately began alphabetising the constellations. Virgo is the editor of the zodiac. It notices typos in the Milky Way. Mars tries to help and is sent to sharpen pencils. Saturn and Virgo exchange a look of perfect understanding and start colour-coding the planets.

reading: Virgo moon energy will feel like wearing someone else's glasses: everything slightly too sharp. You'll notice every crooked picture frame, every email with a missing comma. Fix two. Then stop. The rest can stay charmingly crooked.

The [[Eight of Pentacles]] shows up at your workbench today, steady and focused. Pick one skill and practise it with care for twenty minutes, no shortcuts, no multitasking. The Fire Tiger can be a craftsman when it wants to be. Around 3:15 you'll slip into a little flow pocket and lose track of time. Let it happen.
joel.mission: Spend twenty uninterrupted minutes on one task, with your phone in another room, and time it.
joel.omen: A perfectly straight line of ants on the counter. Small, consistent effort is building something big.

reading: Here's a Virgo moon, and the Wood Rat is in heaven. Lists. Labels. A spreadsheet that finally makes sense. You'll spend a delightful hour organising something that nobody asked you to organise, and it will save three people a lot of fuss next month.

But watch for the Virgo trap: refining something that was already done. If you catch yourself on draft six, step away. The [[Queen of Pentacles]] says good enough is a gift you give your future self. Hand the thing in, then go outside and see if the first lilac buds have shown up yet. They're close. Tight little purple fists.
nancy.mission: Organise one small thing nobody asked you to, then don't mention it until someone discovers it.
nancy.omen: A perfectly folded paper airplane on the ground. Your careful work is about to travel further than expected.

together.text: Each of you pick one task you've been avoiding and set a timer for 25 minutes. Text go when you start, done when you finish. No other messages allowed in between. Virgo is timing you both and has a clipboard.
